manifest.name: dsh-whale-tray
manifest.description: 🐳 大肥鱼 — DeepSeek Harness (dsh) launcher: a Windows tray app and a macOS menu-bar app to start/stop the dsh service, summon the web UI, restart and top up — independent of the dsh process. Ships the compiled desktop apps from Releases.

bundle.text:
# Minimal no-op bundle patch.
#
# This file exists so the package is installable via `dsh plugin add`, which
# requires package.json to declare `dsh.bundle.patch` pointing at a patch file.
#
# 大肥鱼 is a *desktop* launcher (Windows tray / macOS menu-bar). A desktop app
# cannot be distributed through npm, so installing this plugin is a
# discovery/registration entry point rather than the app itself.
#
# macOS — the real install is one command:
#   curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zhqowo/dsh-whale-tray/main/macos/install.sh | zsh
#   (or grab DaFeiYu.app.zip from Releases / build it with macos/build.sh)
# Windows — build WhaleTray.cs with csc.exe (see README).
#
# Why `dsh plugin add` alone cannot finish the job on macOS (npm cannot ship an
# .app, Gatekeeper blocks ad-hoc signatures, TCC grants cannot be automated, and
# paths/ports differ per machine) is written up in macos/README.md.
#
# So this patch intentionally changes nothing.
[]

readme.section: 🐳 大肥鱼 · DeepSeek Harness 启动器
readme.text:
[English](README.en.md) | 中文

DSH(DeepSeek Harness)的**一键开关** —— Windows 是右下角托盘,macOS 是右上角菜单栏。
**独立于 dsh 进程**,类似 Steam 的启动器。

> 🦞 **找 OpenClaw 龙虾?** 那个已经拆到独立仓库了:
> **[zhqowo/openclaw-menubar](https://github.com/zhqowo/openclaw-menubar)** —— 两者受众不同,
> 分开之后各自能被搜到、各自独立发版。

| 平台 | 程序 | 形态 | 源码 |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Windows** | `大肥鱼.exe` | 右下角**托盘** | [`WhaleTray.cs`](WhaleTray.cs) |
| **macOS** | `大肥鱼.app` | 右上角**菜单栏** | [`macos/`](macos/) |

| 操作 | Windows | macOS |
|---|---|---|
| 开关服务 | 右键 → 开启/关闭 | 同 |
| 唤起 Web | 左键 / 双击鲸鱼 | 左键 |
| 切到已开的标签 | 9335 端口 + **配套浏览器扩展** | **AppleScript 直连**,不需要扩展 |
| 重启服务 | 右键 → 重启 | 同 |
| 充值 | 右键 → 充值 | 同 |
| 退出 | 先关 dsh 再退出 | 同 |
| 状态刷新 | 每 2 秒 | 每 3 秒(TCP 探测) |
| 形态 | 托盘 + 隐藏控制台 | 菜单栏,天然静默 |

> **macOS 版不需要浏览器扩展** —— Chromium 系浏览器把标签页暴露给 AppleScript,
> 直接选标签就行。Windows 才需要那套端口轮询 + 扩展。

⚠️ **macOS 版有一个 Windows 没有的大坑:TCC 权限。**
**改代码 / 换机器 / 重新编译之前,务必先读 [`macos/README.md`](macos/README.md) 的 TCC 章节** ——
那三条铁律是踩坑换来的,违反任何一条都会让整套授权静默失效。

---

| 操作 | 行为 |
|---|---|
| 双击 exe | 托盘出现鲸鱼;dsh 没开自动启动(隐藏运行,日志写 `dsh-tray.log`) |
| 左键 / 双击鲸鱼 | 唤起 DSH Web(通过配套浏览器扩展切换后台标签,**不新开页**) |
| 右键 → 开启/关闭大肥鱼 | 动态切换,状态每 2 秒自动刷新 |
| 右键 → 重启服务 | 仅运行时显示;停旧服务 → 等端口释放 → 隐藏重启 |
| 右键 → 充值 | 在 Edge 中打开 `https://platform.deepseek.com/usage` |
| 右键 → 退出 | 先关 dsh 服务,再退出程序 |

- **独立进程**:不依赖 dsh;强杀鲸鱼不影响 dsh,反之亦然
- **唤起 Web 三层方案**:① 窗口标题匹配(前台标签)② 浏览器扩展唤醒后台标签(推荐)③ 兜底新开
- **扩展通信**:本地端口 `9335`(鲸鱼发信号 → 扩展轮询 → `chrome.tabs.update` + `windows.update(state:'normal')`)
- **DPI**:PerMonitorV2 感知 + 系统菜单字体(`app.manifest`)
- **句柄安全**:监听 socket 标记不可继承(防止 dsh 子进程占用端口),端口被占时 20s 自愈重试
- **单实例**:互斥锁防止重复运行

```bat
C:\Windows\Microsoft.NET\Framework64\v4.0.30319\csc.exe /nologo /target:winexe /out:大肥鱼.exe /win32icon:whale.ico /win32manifest:app.manifest /codepage:65001 /r:System.dll /r:System.Drawing.dll /r:System.Windows.Forms.dll /r:System.Web.Extensions.dll /r:UIAutomationClient.dll /r:UIAutomationTypes.dll WhaleTray.cs
```

1. `edge://extensions` → 打开「开发人员模式」
2. 「加载解压缩的扩展」→ 选择 `extension/` 目录
3. 以后点鲸鱼即可静默切换 DSH 标签

Swift + Cocoa 的 `NSStatusItem` 应用。菜单栏右侧一只鲸鱼,**左键切标签、右键弹菜单**
(状态 · 开启/关闭 · 重启 · 打开网页 · 充值 · 退出),运行中彩色 / 停止时半透明。

```sh
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zhqowo/dsh-whale-tray/main/macos/install.sh | zsh
```

它会自动找到你的 dsh、把 app 装进 `/Applications`、装好服务脚本 `dsh-ctl.sh`、写好配置,最后跑一遍体检。
dsh 不在 `~/DeepSeekHarness`?加 `--dir`;端口不是 3080?加 `--port`;不用 Edge?加 `--browser "Google Chrome"`。

```sh

readme.section: 从仓库本地跑(需要先 git clone)
readme.text:
zsh macos/install.sh --dir ~/code/DeepSeekHarness --port 3100 --browser "Google Chrome"
```

**只要你想要"一键启动 + 打开网页",这就完了** —— 唯一需要点的是第一次点「打开网页」时弹的
「大肥鱼 想要控制 Microsoft Edge」,点允许。

```sh
WHALE_APP_OUT=/tmp/staging/大肥鱼.app zsh macos/build.sh   # 暂存,不动你桌面上那份
```

> ⚠️ `zsh macos/build.sh` 不加 `WHALE_APP_OUT` 会**覆盖并重建** `~/Desktop/大肥鱼.app`——
> 那会换 cdhash,让 TCC 里存的授权全部失效。改代码时一律用暂存模式。

细节(配置项、`doctor` 体检、`--print-url` 调试、**为什么不能像插件那样一键装**、
**功能阉割的四档做法**、图标合成、左右键分离原理、AppleScript 的坑、**必读的 TCC 权限章节**)
见 **[`macos/README.md`](macos/README.md)**。

---

readme.section: ⚙️ 配置(可选,两个平台都支持)
readme.text:
**不配置也能用** —— 默认值就是给标准 DeepSeek + dsh 环境准备的。
「充值」写死指向 DeepSeek?我怎么改成别的? 菜单里的**充值**默认打开 `https://platform.deepseek.com/usage`。 但本启动器只管开关 dsh 服务,跟模型供应商无关 —— 你完全可以用别家的模型。 放一个 JSON 配置文件就能改,**不用重新编译**:
平台路径
macOS~/.config/dsh-whale-tray/config.json
Windows%APPDATA%\dsh-whale-tray\config.json

readme.section: ⚙️ 配置(可选,两个平台都支持)
⚙️ 配置(可选,两个平台都支持)
readme.text:
| 键 | 默认值 | 作用 |
|---|---|---|
| `billingUrl` | `https://platform.deepseek.com/usage` | 充值项打开的网址 |
| `billingLabel` | `充值` | 充值项的显示文字 |
| `dshHome` | 自动探测 | **仅 Windows**:dsh 安装根目录 |
| `dshDir` | `~/DeepSeekHarness` | **仅 macOS**:dsh 安装根目录 |
| `port` | `3080` | **仅 macOS**:DSH 端口 |
| `browser` | `Microsoft Edge` | **仅 macOS**:AppleScript 控制哪个浏览器 |
| `logPath` | `<dshDir>/dsh-web.log` | **仅 macOS**:从这个日志捞 `?token=`(0.1.7+ 必需) |
| `workdir` | `<dshDir>/projects` | **仅 macOS**:启动 dsh 时的 cwd |
| `ctlPath` | `<dshDir>/bin/dsh-ctl.sh` | **仅 macOS**:服务脚本位置,一般不用写 |

readme.section: ⚙️ 配置(可选,两个平台都支持)
readme.text:
- **所有键都是可选的**,给几个生效几个
- 文件不存在 / JSON 写错 / 类型不对 → **静默回退默认值**,绝不让托盘或菜单栏起不来
- 命令行 `macos/dsh-ctl.sh billing` 读同一个文件
- macOS 版 `dsh-ctl.sh` 还认环境变量(优先级高于文件):
  `DSH_DIR` `DSH_PORT` `DSH_LOG` `DSH_BIN` `DSH_WORKDIR` `DSH_BROWSER` `DSH_BILLING_URL`
- 不支持 JSON 注释 —— 上面只是为了标注才写成 `jsonc`
</details>

---

readme.section: 作为 DSH 插件安装(只登记清单,不装 app)
readme.text:
本仓库声明了 `dsh.bundle` manifest,所以能被 `dsh plugin add` 认出来:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:zhqowo/dsh-whale-tray
```

> ⚠️ **这条命令不会把菜单栏 app 装到你的 Mac 上。** 它只是把仓库登记进 profile,
> 让插件市场 / `find_dsh_plugin` 能搜到它。
> 装不了的原因有四条:① 桌面 app 没法走 npm 分发 ② ad-hoc 签名会被 Gatekeeper 拦
> ③ TCC 授权没法程序化 ④ 每台机器路径/端口/浏览器都不同。
> 逐条解释 + 你需要在本机做什么 + 只要一部分功能时怎么阉割,全在
> [`macos/README.md`](macos/README.md#为什么不能像插件一样一键装)。
>
> **想真正装好,用上面「一键安装」那条 curl。**

**推荐直接用 [Releases](https://github.com/zhqowo/dsh-whale-tray/releases/latest),
或者上面那条一键安装命令。**

| 位置 | 文件 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| Releases | `DaFeiYu.app.zip` | macOS 菜单栏版;`install.sh` 就拉这个稳定 URL |
| `dist/` | `大肥鱼.app.zip` | 旧的历史存档,保留不动 |

> 🦞 OpenClaw 龙虾的下载在新仓库:
> [openclaw-menubar/releases](https://github.com/zhqowo/openclaw-menubar/releases/latest)

> 因为是 ad-hoc 签名,首次打开会被 Gatekeeper 拦一下:右键 →「打开」,或
> `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/大肥鱼.app`。
> ⚠️ **别再自己重新编译 `大肥鱼.app`** —— 会换 cdhash,让 TCC 授权全部失效。
> 升级到新版同理:截图/点界面报权限错时,把大肥鱼从隐私列表里删掉重新添加一次就好。

```
WhaleTray.cs      # Windows 主程序(C#, WinForms, .NET Framework 4.x)
app.manifest      # Windows DPI 感知清单
extension/        # Windows 配套浏览器扩展(唤醒后台 DSH 标签)
whale*.*          # Windows 图标(裁剪 + 缩放 + 白色提亮修复版)

> 🦞 OpenClaw 龙虾已拆到 [zhqowo/openclaw-menubar](https://github.com/zhqowo/openclaw-menubar)。

**鲸鱼娘立绘不是我画的**,出处如下,两个平台的图标都从这张原图加工而来。

本仓库对原图**没有做美术改动**,只做了机械处理:

| `whale.ico` | Windows | 原图裁剪 → 缩放到 16/32/48/256 → 打包 ico |

readme.section: 🐳 Da Fei Yu — DeepSeek Harness Launcher
readme.text:
English | [中文](README.md)

One-click start/stop for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) (dsh) —
a **system tray** app on Windows, a **menu-bar** app on macOS. **Runs as an independent process**,
like a Steam launcher for dsh.

> 🦞 **Looking for the OpenClaw Lobster?** It now lives in its own repo:
> **[zhqowo/openclaw-menubar](https://github.com/zhqowo/openclaw-menubar)** — the two serve
> different audiences, so splitting them lets each be discovered and released on its own.

| Platform | Program | Shape | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Windows** | `大肥鱼.exe` | system tray (bottom-right) | [`WhaleTray.cs`](WhaleTray.cs) |
| **macOS** | `大肥鱼.app` | menu bar (top-right) | [`macos/`](macos/) |

| Action | Windows | macOS |
|---|---|---|
| Toggle service | right-click → start/stop | same |
| Wake the Web UI | left / double-click the whale | left click |
| Switch to the existing tab | port `9335` + **companion extension** | **AppleScript**, no extension needed |
| Restart service | right-click → restart | same |
| Top-up page | right-click → top-up | same |
| Exit | stops dsh first, then exits | same |
| State refresh | every 2 s | every 3 s (TCP probe) |
| Shape | tray + hidden console | menu bar, silent by nature |

> **The macOS build needs no browser extension** — Chromium browsers expose their tabs to
> AppleScript, so we just select the tab. Only Windows needs the port-polling + extension combo.

⚠️ **macOS has a trap Windows doesn't: TCC permissions.**
**Before changing code, moving machines, or rebuilding, read the TCC section of
[`macos/README.md`](macos/README.md).** Its three rules were paid for in debugging time —
violating any of them silently kills every permission the app has.

---

| Action | Behavior |
|---|---|
| Double-click exe | Whale icon appears in the tray; auto-starts dsh if not running (hidden, logs to `dsh-tray.log`) |
| Left / double-click the whale | Brings up the DSH Web UI (switches to the background tab via the companion extension — **no duplicate tabs**) |
| Right-click → Toggle | Switch dsh on/off; state refreshes every 2 s |
| Right-click → Restart | Shown only while dsh runs; stops the old service → waits for the port → restarts hidden |
| Right-click → Top-up | Opens `https://platform.deepseek.com/usage` in Edge |
| Right-click → Exit | Stops the dsh service first, then exits |

- **Independent process**: does not depend on dsh; force-killing the whale does not affect dsh and vice versa
- **Wake-up, three layers**: ① window-title match (foreground tab) ② extension switches the background tab (recommended) ③ fallback: open a new tab
- **Extension channel**: local port `9335` (whale signals → extension polls → `chrome.tabs.update` + `windows.update(state:'normal')`)
- **DPI**: PerMonitorV2 awareness + system menu font (`app.manifest`)
- **Handle safety**: listener socket marked non-inheritable; 20 s self-healing rebind when the port is taken
- **Single instance**: mutex prevents duplicate runs

```bat
C:\Windows\Microsoft.NET\Framework64\v4.0.30319\csc.exe /nologo /target:winexe /out:DaFeiYu.exe /win32icon:whale.ico /win32manifest:app.manifest /codepage:65001 /r:System.dll /r:System.Drawing.dll /r:System.Windows.Forms.dll /r:System.Web.Extensions.dll /r:UIAutomationClient.dll /r:UIAutomationTypes.dll WhaleTray.cs
```

1. Open `edge://extensions` → enable **Developer mode**
2. Click **Load unpacked** → select the `extension/` folder
3. Clicking the whale now silently switches to the DSH tab

A Swift + Cocoa `NSStatusItem` app. A whale in the menu bar: **left click switches to the DSH tab,
right click opens the menu** (status · toggle · restart · open web · top-up · quit); full colour while
running, dimmed while stopped.

```sh
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zhqowo/dsh-whale-tray/main/macos/install.sh | zsh
```

It locates your dsh, installs the app into `/Applications`, drops the `dsh-ctl.sh` service script,
writes the config, and finishes with a health check. dsh somewhere else? `--dir`. Not port 3080?
`--port`. Not Edge? `--browser "Google Chrome"`.

```sh

readme.section: run from a local checkout instead
readme.text:
zsh macos/install.sh --dir ~/code/DeepSeekHarness --port 3100 --browser "Google Chrome"
```

**If all you want is "start it with one click, open the UI", you are done** — the only thing you must
click is the one-time *"Da Fei Yu wants to control Microsoft Edge"* Automation prompt.

readme.section: Build it yourself (when hacking on the code)
readme.text:
```sh
WHALE_APP_OUT=/tmp/staging/DaFeiYu.app zsh macos/build.sh   # staging: your Desktop copy is untouched
```

> ⚠️ `zsh macos/build.sh` **without** `WHALE_APP_OUT` overwrites and rebuilds `~/Desktop/大肥鱼.app` —
> which changes its cdhash and invalidates every TCC permission. Always use staging while developing.

readme.section: Build it yourself (when hacking on the code)
readme.text:
Details — config keys, the `doctor` health check, `--print-url` debugging,
**why this cannot be installed like a plugin**, **the four tiers of feature trimming**, icon
composition, left/right click separation, AppleScript gotchas, and the **must-read TCC permission
section** — live in [`macos/README.md`](macos/README.md).

---

**It works with no configuration at all** — the defaults target a standard DeepSeek + dsh setup.
The "Top up" item points at DeepSeek — how do I change it? The menu's **Top up** entry opens `https://platform.deepseek.com/usage` by default. But this launcher only starts/stops the dsh service — it has nothing to do with which model provider you use, and you are free to run something other than DeepSeek.

Drop a JSON file and you can repoint it **without recompiling**:
PlatformPath
macOS~/.config/dsh-whale-tray/config.json
Windows%APPDATA%\dsh-whale-tray\config.json
> The `DSH_WHALE_TRAY_CONFIG` environment variable overrides the path on either platform.

| key | default | what it does |
|---|---|---|
| `billingUrl` | `https://platform.deepseek.com/usage` | page the billing entry opens |
| `billingLabel` | `充值` | label of that menu item |
| `dshHome` | auto-detected | **Windows only**: dsh install root |
| `dshDir` | `~/DeepSeekHarness` | **macOS only**: dsh install root |
| `port` | `3080` | **macOS only**: DSH port |
| `browser` | `Microsoft Edge` | **macOS only**: which browser AppleScript drives |
| `logPath` | `<dshDir>/dsh-web.log` | **macOS only**: where the `?token=` is harvested from (required on 0.1.7+) |
| `workdir` | `<dshDir>/projects` | **macOS only**: cwd when starting dsh |
| `ctlPath` | `<dshDir>/bin/dsh-ctl.sh` | **macOS only**: service script location, rarely needed |

- **Every key is optional** — set only the ones you care about
- Missing file / malformed JSON / wrong type → **silently falls back to the defaults**; the tray
  or menu bar must never fail to come up over an optional config
- The CLI (`macos/dsh-ctl.sh billing`) reads the same file
- macOS `dsh-ctl.sh` also honours environment variables (they win over the file):
  `DSH_DIR` `DSH_PORT` `DSH_LOG` `DSH_BIN` `DSH_WORKDIR` `DSH_BROWSER` `DSH_BILLING_URL`
- JSON comments are not supported — the block above is marked `jsonc` only to allow annotations
</details>

> ⚠️ **This does not install the menu-bar app on your Mac.** It only registers the repo in your
> profile so the plugin market / `find_dsh_plugin` can find it.
> Four things block a true one-step install: ① desktop apps cannot be distributed over npm
> ② ad-hoc signing gets stopped by Gatekeeper ③ TCC grants cannot be automated
> ④ install path, port and browser differ per machine.
> The full explanation, what you need to do locally, and how to trim features are in
> [`macos/README.md`](macos/README.md).

installer above.**
